acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Guest host Bim Adewunmi talks to Mona Chalabi about why she sometimes feels like an imposter in her own home.

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Sandy Allen tells the story of learning to play an instrument that suddenly sounds very different — his own voice.
acts.title: Voice Over

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Writer Marie Phillips has a short story about a strange man in a parking lot, offering to grant one wish.
acts.title: Me Minus You

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: When Karla Cornejo Villavicencio decided to make a change that had the potential to alter who she’s known herself to be for many years, she didn’t know who would emerge.
acts.title: One Pill Made Me Small
